description: Satirical composite image captioned 'Happy Holidays'. Cut-out photographs of California Governor Gavin Newsom and House Speaker Nancy Pelosi, posed smiling like a greeting-card couple, are superimposed over a backdrop of a raging California wildfire with hillside homes engulfed in flames and smoke. The juxtaposition mocks the two California politicians against the state's wildfire destruction; filename 'CA.JPG' references California.
flags: Photoshopped composite - the politicians were not actually photographed in front of the fire

description: Movie-poster-style graphic titled 'PANIC IN DC', styled as a redacted TOP SECRET//NOFORN document with a blue silhouette of the Washington D.C. skyline (Capitol dome, Washington Monument, Lincoln Memorial, White House). Quotes the Q-drop phrase 'They never thought she would lose' attributed to Q, and carries the tagline 'In theaters now'. 'PANIC IN DC' is a recurring Q-drop slogan; the redaction bars and FOIA exemption codes (b1, b3, b7A, b7E) evoke declassified documents.
text: TOP SECRET//NOFORN. "THEY NEVER THOUGHT SHE WOULD LOSE" -Q. PANIC. IN DC. b1- b3- b7A- b7E-. TOP SECRET//NOFORN. IN THEATERS NOW
terms: they never thought she would lose

description: Ben Garrison political cartoon. Donald Trump flips on a kitchen light switch ('CLICK') and catches four figures labeled Kerry, Romney, Biden and Pelosi with their hands in a giant cookie jar labeled 'Ukraine Cookies', filled with dollar-sign cookies; they point at Trump and shout 'AHA! WE CAUGHT YOU!'. The cartoon claims the politicians accusing Trump over Ukraine were themselves profiting from Ukraine. Signed Ben Garrison, @grrrgraphics.com.
text: CLICK. AHA! WE CAUGHT YOU!. KERRY. ROMNEY. BIDEN. PELOSI. TAP TAP!. UKRAINE COOKIES. BEN GARRISON. @GRRRGRAPHICS.COM
flags: Editorial cartoon asserting an unverified corruption claim about the depicted politicians

description: Distressed white Punisher skull logo on a black background, apparently a phone-screenshot of the graphic (tall aspect ratio with a home-bar at the bottom). The Punisher skull, from the Marvel comics vigilante character, was repeatedly attached to Q drops as a signal of impending punishment of the 'deep state'. No text.
